correctness.rationale: Each induced survivor graph is a forest, so C=|S|-X, where X counts fully retained edges. In fixed-size sampling, pairs of edge indicators have joint retention a3 or a4 according to whether they meet; exactly W unordered pairs meet. In Bernoulli sampling, each pair of incident edges contributes covariance p^3(1-p), and each edge has two vertex-edge covariances p^2(1-p). These identities yield the stated means and variances including the boundary cases. The nonnegative degree surpluses sum to n-2, and shared pairs of surplus units are minimized exactly by the path and maximized exactly by the star; the gap in W is (n-2)(n-3)/2. Its variance coefficients are strictly positive on the stated ranges. Independent exact Prüfer enumeration through n=6 and reduction by tree-center codes gave 1,1,1,2,3,6 types and only one repeated degree signature, at six vertices. For the specified trees a second direct check uses C(T without v,w)=deg(v)+deg(w)-1-1_{vw}: all unordered pairs have degree-sum counts (3,6,4,2) at sums 2 through 5, and the edge pairs at sums 3 through 5 have counts (1,3,1) in A and (2,1,2) in B. Hence the four-retention histograms are (4,8,2,1) and (5,5,5,0), with the claimed centered moments. For other k the twin laws match (k<=3 by edge and wedge counts, k=5 by the degree of the omitted vertex, k=6 by connectedness). The only contribution to the Bernoulli third-moment difference is then 6p^4(1-p)^2. The uploaded verifier was inspected, not executed.
